title: [profiler][cupti] Remove unused Python reference decoder (CuptiMonitorBuffer)
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #188096
* #186812
* #188210

The CUPTI monitor decodes completed activity buffers in the native GIL-free
worker (the _cupti_monitor_native decode thread feeding
CuptiMonitor._columns_from_native). The Python CuptiMonitorBuffer.decode()
that this was originally derived from has no production caller anymore -- the
class was only instantiated by a unit test, which is removed in the tests
commit. Drop the dead reference decoder; keep _deref_cstr (still used by the
native column post-processing).

The shipping decode path stays covered end-to-end by
test_v2_columnar_collection (field selection, column alignment, const char*
deref) plus the multi-kind profiler tests.

Authored with the assistance of an AI coding assistant.
